tables.title: FDCAN register map and reset values
tables.text_helper: Table 485, "FDCAN register map and reset values", in section 46.5.38 (FDCAN register map) on page 2083. Register map: offsets, 32-bit field layout and reset values for 38 registers: FDCAN_CREL, FDCAN_ENDN, Reserved, FDCAN_DBTP, FDCAN_TEST, FDCAN_RWD, FDCAN_CCCR, FDCAN_NBTP, FDCAN_TSCC, FDCAN_TSCV, FDCAN_TOCC, FDCAN_TOCV and 26 more.
